summary: Discover the essentials of ISO/IEC 27005:2022 Risk Manager. Enhance your organization's risk management strategies with our comprehensive insights and resources
audienceIntro: This training course is for: Managers or consultants who handle information security in an organization. People who manage information security risks. Members of information security teams, IT professionals, and privacy officers. Those who ensure compliance with the information security standards of ISO/IEC 27001 in an organization. Project managers, consultants, or advisers who want to learn about managing information security risks
